result.subject: Request for Lab Tour During Engineering Expedition
result.body:
Your work on reinforcement learning for manipulation at UC Berkeley continues to shape the field of autonomous systems. We are a small group of engineering students visiting the San Francisco Bay Area to explore cutting-edge research and its real-world applications. Our expedition aims to deepen our understanding of how theoretical concepts translate into practical solutions.

We are particularly interested in your research on sim-to-real transfer, as it addresses a critical challenge in deploying robotic systems in dynamic environments. Our group hopes to learn more about the methodologies and challenges involved in bridging the gap between simulation and physical implementation.

We would be honored to request a 30-minute lab tour during our visit. We are happy to adapt to your schedule and are flexible regarding the timing. Thank you for considering our request.
